# Zhiqiang Power — Luchuan County Zhiqiang Motor Factory

> Factory-direct diesel generator sets from 30 kW to 2200 kW, built at our own plant in Luchuan County, Guangxi, China, around genuine Yuchai diesel engines and in-house TFW brushless alternators. We sell complete generating sets - open skid, silent canopy and containerised - into Vietnam, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia, Myanmar, Indonesia and Singapore. Every set is load-bank tested from 0% to 110% load before it is packed.

Key facts:
- Legal name: Luchuan County Zhiqiang Motor Factory (陆川县志强电机厂)
- Founded: 2003
- Address: West side of Longhao Entrepreneurship Park, Luchuan County, Yulin, Guangxi, China 537700
- Phone / WhatsApp: +86 150 5749 1423
- Tel / Fax: +86 775 7231555
- Sales email: tommy@zhiqiang-power.com
- After-sales email: as@zhiqiang-power.com
- Factory certification: ISO 9001 (quality management). This is the only factory certificate we hold; we claim no other.
- Emissions: declared per engine model as non-road T2, non-road T3 or non-road T4 under China GB 20891, following the -D2x / -D3x / -D4x model suffix.
- Ratings: ISO 8528-1 (prime PRP / standby ESP). Fuel figures: ISO 3046-1 reference conditions.
- We sell complete diesel generator sets only. Alternators, engines and spare parts are supplied for the sets we build.
- Warranty: 1 year; operator training free for the life of the set.

## Catalogue
- [products/](https://zhiqiang-power.com/products/): Generator sets: 27 models from 30 kW to 2200 kW, 50/60 Hz, with fuel curves and dimensions.
- [engines/](https://zhiqiang-power.com/engines/): Yuchai diesel engines: 24 generator-drive models across 14 series.
- [alternators/](https://zhiqiang-power.com/alternators/): Alternators wound in-house: 46 TFW, STC and ST models, 3 kW to 600 kW.
- [generator-types/](https://zhiqiang-power.com/generator-types/): Enclosure forms: open skid, silent canopy, containerised and trailer-mounted, with the power band each covers.
- [diesel-generator-price/](https://zhiqiang-power.com/diesel-generator-price/): Price guide: what drives the cost of a set, and what to send us for a quotation.
- [parts/](https://zhiqiang-power.com/parts/): Genuine spare parts and maintenance kits (250 h / 500 h / 1000 h / 3000 h).
- [request-a-quote/](https://zhiqiang-power.com/request-a-quote/): One RFQ form for generator sets; an engineer replies with configuration, price and shipping.

## Markets
- [countries/vietnam.html](https://zhiqiang-power.com/countries/vietnam.html): Diesel generators in Vietnam — 220V / 380V · 50Hz, CR Mark – only mandatory for products within QCVN/CR scope (8502 gensets: confirm coverage by HS before shipment).
- [countries/philippines.html](https://zhiqiang-power.com/countries/philippines.html): Diesel generators in Philippines — 220V / 380V / 480V · 60Hz (1800 RPM), According to publicly referenced trade repository guidance, HS 8502 generating sets may not appear on the mandatory product certification list at import level; project-level permits (e.g. LGU, DENR-EMB for certain ratings) can still apply. Always re-verify with the importer and current official sources..
- [countries/thailand.html](https://zhiqiang-power.com/countries/thailand.html): Diesel generators in Thailand — 230V / 400V · 50Hz, TISI standards compliance (confirm TIS applicability by model) + MOE import permit for >50kVA.
- [countries/malaysia.html](https://zhiqiang-power.com/countries/malaysia.html): Diesel generators in Malaysia — 240V / 415V · 50Hz, SIRIM / ST Electrical Approval (Guidelines 2024 Ed., in force since Jun 2025).
- [countries/myanmar.html](https://zhiqiang-power.com/countries/myanmar.html): Diesel generators in Myanmar — 220V / 380V · 50Hz, Import License via Tradenet 2.0 (buyer) + Form E Certificate of Origin.
- [countries/indonesia.html](https://zhiqiang-power.com/countries/indonesia.html): Diesel generators in Indonesia — 220V / 380V · 50Hz, SNI (Standar Nasional Indonesia) applies only within the mandatory product scope; installation SLO (Sertifikat Laik Operasi) is issued by an accredited inspection body — confirm both against current regulations with the importer before shipment.
- [countries/singapore.html](https://zhiqiang-power.com/countries/singapore.html): Diesel generators in Singapore — 230V / 400V · 50Hz, Singapore regulates exhaust emissions from new non-road diesel engines and requires ultra-low-sulphur diesel; publicly referenced guidance cites EU Stage V / US EPA Tier 4 Final equivalence, with engine registration handled through NEA. Electrical installation work must be carried out by an EMA-licensed electrical worker (LEW). Confirm model-level applicability and any standby/emergency exemption with the importer before shipment..
